purpose: SHA-256 of the committed prebuilt Rust libraries (libdlcplazacryptlib.so and the libsecp256k1_zkp it loads) AS THEY ARE SHIPPED in a release APK or AAB, that is after the Android Gradle plugin has stripped them (llvm-strip --strip-unneeded, NDK 27.0.12077973). tool/verify_android_release.py compares every shipped library with this list. The files under flutter_plugin/flutter_plugin/android/src/main/jniLibs/ are the unstripped inputs. Changing a library is a reviewed change of both.
source: Identical, after the same stripping, in the two archived APKs of the published 1.0.3 (1000034) lineage and in the CI build manifests (native_lib_sha256). Recorded 2026-10-22 (Issue #72).
